HostDiagnostic.description: A finding of the host about the request, beside the model's own.

Limits.description: The declared limits. A request may lower any of them, never raise one.

member_bytes.description: Bytes of one member or profile.

basis_digest.description: `sha256:` over the sorted `(id, revision)` pairs of every record.

ModelDiagnostic.description: A finding about the model itself.

record.description: The record it is about, or the path when no record could be formed.

ObservationUse.description: Which observations the run used. Every one is assumed.

authenticated.description: Always false: a hosted run authenticates no observation.

Projection.description: One rendered projection, or why it is not.

path.description: Basis-relative path where the standalone compiler commits it.

governed_by.description:
Who governs it (a Liminal Jurisdiction), where that is defined: a
Warrant's authorizer once authorized; a Warrant's own records, their
Warrant; a deliverable, the Warrant that governs its path now
(OW-ADR-0021); a phase, whoever accepted the roadmap; an item, its
ticket. Absent where nobody does.

revision.description:
`sha256:<hex>` of its own bytes, else of the file that holds it; a
Warrant's is its contract digest as it compiles now.

source.description: Repository-relative path of the file that holds it.

kind.description:
`part_of`, `parent`, `supersedes`, `roadmap`, `implements`,
`depends_on` or `promoted_to`; from authored relations (OW-WAR-0148
M3), any core kind or a namespaced one (`x.mentions`), which is
carried and drives nothing.

to_revision.description:
The revision of `to` the relation pins (`REQ-pr1@sha256:…`), when it
pins one. A pin that is not `to`'s revision now reads stale.

State.description: A state a builder derives for a record.

provenance.description: `recorded` (read from a record of an act) or `computed`.

basis.description: The basis echoed: its id and the digest the host recomputed.

limits.description: The limits this run held to.

model.description: The compiled `oh.war/model/v1`; null when refused or not compiled.

model_digest.description: `sha256:` of the model's compact JSON bytes, as serialized here.

projections.description: In request order, `*` expanded in alias order.
